$comment: How art shapes attach to one another. The shape contracts say what a part IS; this says where it goes and how it joins. Derived from the V6/V7 assembly graph produced by the shapes-from-2D project, with every anchor and part rewritten to the art.* id it corresponds to -- all 36 mapped exactly, which is why the join is worth making explicit.

provenance.note: Synthetic and rule-based, like the shape contracts it references: joint types and socket offsets are authored construction rules, not measurements of real assets. Angular limits are NOT part of this data, which is why the range-versus-topology rule remains unanswerable.
